title: National Partnership Emails 2013-2021
notes: The exact 15 MB PDF was uploaded directly into the research conversation and hashed before analysis. The GitHub connector available to this project handles UTF-8 files well but is not suitable for committing this binary at its present size. The user can preserve the exact evidence copy by placing the PDF at sources/raw/national-partnership/NPP_Emails_2013_2021.pdf; after that the SHA-256 can be checked against this manifest.
